new.pl: T29N R1E sec. 26, Town of Mayville, Clark County
new.st: The 1893 plat book of Clark County (C. S. Stockwell) draws a schoolhouse at the north line of sec. 26, on the J. Breyer land, T29N R1E (Town of Mayville). No GNIS school is within 1.5 km, so this is a school the later lists missed.
new.t: Country school yards: look along the road edge and where the outhouse and woodshed stood behind the school.
src: Clark County Plats (C. S. Stockwell, Neillsville, 1893), Mayville page (T29N R1E)
pinev: Placed from the 1893 plat on the fitted section grid, good to about 100-150 m

vs-1840251.st: The 1893 Clark County plat draws this schoolhouse at the northwest corner of the Carl Meyer land, sec. 9 T29N R1E, about 150 m from the pin, so it was standing by 1893.
src: Clark County Plats (C. S. Stockwell, Neillsville, 1893), Mayville page (T29N R1E)

vs-1840248.st: The 1893 Clark County plat draws a schoolhouse at the southwest corner of sec. 7 T29N R1E on the range line, about 200 m from the pin, so it was standing by 1893.
src: Clark County Plats (C. S. Stockwell, Neillsville, 1893), Mayville page (T29N R1E)
